video.title: AI欧腐《和橄榄球死对头假装恋爱/Fake Dating My Football Rival》
video.desc:
To save their college football team, Alan and his nemesis Leo fake date for a men's underwear campaign. What Alan doesn't know is that Leo has had feelings for him all along. As Leo uses the contract to get closer, Alan's resistance slowly turns into something more, until his mother's words finally make him face the truth.
为了拯救大学橄榄球队，Alan和他的死对头Leo不得不接下一个男士内衣广告，并在广告合约中假扮情侣。
Alan并不知道，Leo其实早就对他动了心。借着这份“假恋爱”合约，Leo一步步靠近他；而Alan原本的抗拒，也在相处中慢慢变成了说不清的心动。
直到母亲的一番话，终于让Alan不得不正视自己的真心。
